name: Paramparagat Krishi Vikas Yojana
benefit:
> **Financial Assistance for Organic Farming Cluster:**

- Total assistance of ₹14,95,030/- per cluster of 20 hectares (50 acres) for 3 years.
- Maximum assistance of ₹10,00,000/- per cluster for farmer members.
- Maximum assistance of ₹50,000/- per farmer per hectare, limited to 1 hectare per farmer.

> **Participatory Guarantee System (PGS) Certification:**

- Assistance for mobilization of farm
_eligibility_text: - The applicant must be a farmer willing to adopt organic farming practices. - The applicant must be part of a cluster or Local Group formed under the Participatory Guarantee System (PGS)-India programme. - The applicant must be a member of a cluster covering approximately 20 hectares (50 acres) in a contiguous area.
